description: Call this tool for a SEPA payment QR from just an amount and reference: IBAN and name are read from the shared business profile, never asked for; pass invoice_id instead to take the amount from an invoice.

amount.description: Amount in EUR. Overrides the invoice total; required when there is no invoice to read

error_correction.description: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code recoverable when damaged

iban.description: Override the IBAN in the shared business profile

invoice_id.description: Invoice number, for example INV-2026-0007. Read from the invoice server's store if it is present

margin.description: Quiet zone in modules, default 4, which is what the QR standard requires

name.description: Override the beneficiary name in the shared business profile

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-code. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; a PNG always comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name already produced in this request (default false)

reference.description: Payment text, up to 140 characters. Defaults to the invoice number

size.description: PNG width in pixels, 32 to 4000 (default 300). SVG scales without it

name: invoice_payment_qr
title: Payment QR for an invoice
